title: Pinnacle Navratri 2026 Offer
limit: Only for the first 4,999 kids and families.
description: One full month of one service: Speech Therapy (ST), Occupational Therapy (OT), Behaviour Therapy (BT) or Special Education (SE).
terms: The care team confirms eligibility, selected service, suitable centre, schedule and remaining availability before enrolment. Services are not bundled.
